_comment: Corrections to harvested rows where Wikidata itself is wrong. Applied by scripts/dedupe-places.mjs on every run (after the harvest), so the nightly harvest cannot put the mistake back. A value of null removes that field. Each fix: the fields to set (name, lat, lon, startYear, endYear, placeNote, dateNote, born, died), why, and the source checked. A moved pin is also listed in wikidata-coord-exceptions.json so the 25 km lint knows it is deliberate.
